The '''Garena Premier League Season 1''' was the first full season of the [[Garena Premier League]] ('''GPL'''), held from May 18 to November 17, 2012. The competition was hosted in Singapore, with offline matches played at the Garena Stadium, and featured six teams from across Southeast Asia. The Group Stage was played as an Octuple Round Robin with best-of-one matches. The top three teams advanced to the Playoffs, which used a King of the Hill format: the second and third seeds met in the Semifinals in best-of-three, while the first seed received a direct bye to the Grand Finals, played as a best-of-five. The tournament featured a total prize pool of $63,500 {{Abbr/USD}}.
